baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ
baseline_models.mechanism: The spoken prompt makes the hearers inspect a live provenance condition: possible occurrence from divine presence is set before their act of denying it. The construction diagnoses the risk in rejection without requiring the conditional itself to assert its premise.

activation_trace.role: The command externalizes the provenance test as an utterance addressed to the rejecters.
The alerting and interrogative force of أرأيتم demands considered disclosure, not bare eyesight.
Occurrence or presence supplies the live condition under which the response is tested.
Proximity and presence make the proposed source immediate rather than merely remote attribution.
Denial and obstruction of truth name the response whose consequence the question exposes.

changed_reading.before: A command simply to assert divine origin and condemn disbelief.
changed_reading.after: A command to test the hearers' position under the still-live possibility of divine origin, making premature rejection itself the object of judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ... فِى شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah maps a spatial reversal. Something posited as coming from nearness to God is met by covering, and the respondent is finally located on an opposite side whose separation extends far. Rejection is the pivot between source-nearness and receiver-distance.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence establish the source-side of the spatial contrast.
Covering supplies the intervening act that blocks relation to the near source.
The opposed half or side gives the final condition a concrete bilateral geometry.
Communal fracture and opposition turn that geometry into an adversarial relation.
Spatial and معنوي remoteness extend the split away from its source.
Distance pursued within hostility sharpens بعيد from neutral remoteness into sustained opposition.

changed_reading.before: The rejecter merely holds a doctrinal disagreement far from the truth.
changed_reading.after: The sentence places the rejecter on the far opposite side of something proposed as arriving from divine nearness, so distance is a produced relation rather than a static label.

baseline_models.mechanism: The material image of covering meets the hiddenness and loss branches of ضلال. The comparative can therefore describe a reflexive process: suppressing the available object makes it disappear from the suppressor's own field of guidance.

activation_trace.role: Covering and occlusion provide the initiating material action.
Disappearance into hiddenness renders what was covered unavailable to the coverer.
Loss of the object or route converts occlusion into practical disorientation.
Seeing by eye or insight is the capacity against which covering and hiddenness operate.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief and error are two adjacent moral predicates.
changed_reading.after: The question exposes a feedback loop in which covering the sign produces hiddenness, loss, and thus deeper disorientation for the one who covers it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated descent, textual joining, detailed articulation, arrival, and denial turn the focus conditional into a compressed provenance-risk test. The possibility in 41:52 gathers a delivery chain already distributed across the surah without ceasing to be grammatically conditional.

activation_trace.role: The focus phrase anchors the model in proposed origin from divine presence.
Delivery and conveyance introduce a movement from source to recipients at the surah's opening.
Ordered written language gives the delivered object a joined and inspectable form.
Detailed articulation makes the object's parts and meanings available rather than concealed.
Denial when the reminder arrives supplies the enacted response later restaged conditionally.
A second source-to-recipient delivery formula closes the textual frame immediately before the focus sequence.

structural_cues: The source construction with مِن recurs in 41:2, 41:42, and 41:52.
41:41 places denial at the moment of arrival, while 41:52 converts that event into a direct second-person conditional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated descent, a detailed written object, arrival, and denial; I infer that these specify the likely referent and evidential history of به, while the live alternative is that 41:52 leaves the antecedent deliberately unfilled and purely hypothetical.

changed_reading.before: The ayah poses an unsupported hypothetical about an unspecified thing being from God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah compresses an already traced delivery and denial sequence into a personal risk question: what if the articulated thing that reached you really has the source repeatedly claimed for it?

context_deltas.mechanism: Inner coverings, weighted ears, and an interposed barrier become the mechanics of the distant call. The focus phrase شقاق بعيد names the endpoint of a communication geometry constructed by the recipients themselves.

activation_trace.role: Opposition and group fracture anchor the communication break in the focus ayah.
Remoteness states the resulting communicative position.
Protective covering becomes a self-described enclosure around reception.
Weight in the ear materially blocks the sound channel.
Prevention of access supplies the barrier between speaker and hearers.
The repeated ear-weight confirms persistence of the same reception failure.
The range and distance of a raised call translates blocked reception into spatial remoteness.
The exact distant-place description prefigures the focus ayah's بعيد.

structural_cues: 41:5 and 41:44 both pair ear burden with separation from the message.
The repeated بعيد moves from the location of a call in 41:44 to the state of schism in 41:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coverings, ear-weight, a barrier, and a call experienced from afar; I infer a directional arrow from sustained blocking to communicative distance, while a live alternative is that the images independently describe an already existing refusal.

changed_reading.before: Far schism is an abstract theological distance imposed as a verdict.
changed_reading.after: Far schism is the accumulated communications state made by enclosing the heart, weighting hearing, and maintaining a barrier until even a nearby call is experienced as remote.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance is supplied, blindness is preferred, hearing is prohibited, and mixed noise is deliberately produced. These cues revise أضل from uninformed wandering into chosen anti-reception that actively degrades the conditions of finding a route.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance and purpose anchors the revised sense of comparative disorientation.
Gentle indication toward the path is explicitly present both as supplied guidance and named guidance.
Heart-held preference supplies volition in selecting the contrary condition.
Blindness of insight is the preferred substitute for guidance.
Understanding and compliance are directly targeted by the command not to listen.
Mixed disruptive noise makes non-reception an active collective practice.

structural_cues: 41:17 grammatically places blindness as the selected object over guidance.
41:26 changes non-hearing from a condition into an imperative and a tactic for prevailing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a preference construction and an organized listening blockade; I infer that these make the focus comparative culpably agential, while the alternative is that أضل remains a result-state without specifying how responsibility is distributed.

changed_reading.before: The most astray person simply lacks correct information or direction.
changed_reading.after: The comparative marks the one who receives direction yet chooses blindness and then organizes the sensory conditions that keep direction from being heard.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covering branch of كفر is tested against attempted concealment that fails: hearing, sight, and skin testify, mistaken supposition causes ruin, and deviators are explicitly not hidden. The focus prompt asks the coverer to see a strategy whose result is exposure rather than secrecy.

activation_trace.role: Covering anchors the attempted concealment mechanism in the focus verb.
The interrogative alert turns the failed concealment back into an object of self-inspection.
Literal covering and concealment supply the attempted protective strategy.
Presence with witnessed disclosure makes the supposedly covered acts testify against their agents.
Unreliable supposition identifies the epistemic mistake sustaining concealment.
The source negates hiddenness, closing off the coverer's hoped-for result.
Seeing at the close of the ayah supplies the observing counterforce to concealment.

structural_cues: 41:22 negates successful self-covering before listing bodily witnesses.
41:40 directly negates the hiddenness of those who incline within the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, testimony, false supposition, negated hiddenness, and sight; I infer that the literal covering image of كفر participates in the same failed strategy, while the alternative is to keep كفر solely in its conventional denial branch.

changed_reading.before: كفرتم records a denial that can remain inward or hidden.
changed_reading.after: كفرتم becomes attempted occlusion that paradoxically stores up witnesses and exposes the coverer, so أرأيتم demands recognition of concealment's failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who rejected earlier ask to be shown the two who misled them and seek to place those agents below. The focus ayah reuses seeing and misguidance but redirects the diagnostic toward the present second-person rejecters, interrupting the transfer of all agency to external misleaders.

activation_trace.role: The alerting question addresses the current agents and asks for their own judgment.
The comparative departure from guidance is now predicated within the hearers' own scenario.
A request to be shown external misleaders establishes the earlier direction of visual attribution.
Causative misguidance locates blame in two named external agents.
Deliberate placement turns attribution into an intended rearrangement of rank.
Low status supplies the punitive destination assigned to the blamed agents.

structural_cues: 41:29 and 41:52 pair the same seeing and misguidance roots in reversed address situations.
The request أَرِنَا targets others, whereas أَرَءَيْتُمْ makes the current hearers perform the diagnostic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier request to display external misleaders and a later second-person question about extreme misguidance; I infer a redirection of responsibility, while the live alternative is that 41:52 continues to describe an unnamed third party rather than the addressed rejecters.

changed_reading.before: The question only identifies some maximally misguided other person.
changed_reading.after: The question returns the seeing-and-blame operation to those who had externalized misguidance, forcing them to consider whether their own rejection occupies the comparative extreme.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two sequences pivot on God and then diverge: saying our Lord is God is followed by standing straight, whereas possible origin from God is followed by covering and far schism. The shared ثم marks opposed trajectories of response rather than incidental chronology.

activation_trace.role: The divine name fixes the source-point from which the focus trajectory turns.
Denial is the post-ثم action on the diverging trajectory.
Fracture is the relational endpoint of that response.
Spoken confession functions as an adopted conviction and initiates the contrasting sequence.
The same divine name supplies the common pivot in the earlier sequence.
Straightness and balanced uprightness provide the opposed post-ثم course.

structural_cues: 41:30 has قَالُوا رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَامُوا, while 41:52 has مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم.
Both sequences move from relation to God through ثم into a durable human posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated divine name, ثم, and opposite response vocabularies; I infer a deliberate trajectory contrast, while the alternative is that the shared sequencing is local phrasing without an inter-ayah opposition.

changed_reading.before: ثم merely advances the hypothetical from divine origin to a later act of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: ثم marks a fork already modeled in the surah: relation to God can continue as upright alignment or turn through covering into widening fracture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah gives an inverse operation for relational distance: repelling with what is better transforms enmity across the interval into immediate alliance and intimate nearness. This makes far schism a live relational configuration with a described counter-mechanism, not an ontologically fixed separation.

activation_trace.role: Adversarial fracture anchors the relation that the earlier mechanism can invert.
Distance carried far in hostility names the unrepaired endpoint.
Pushing away harm with a better act supplies the active reversal mechanism.
The interval between parties is the gap whose relational quality changes.
Explicit enmity supplies the initial state corresponding to schism.
Nearness without a separating interval supplies the transformed relation.
Intimate kin-like closeness intensifies the collapse of distance.

structural_cues: 41:34 explicitly changes the relation between two parties from عداوة to ولي حميم.
41:52 combines opposition with distance, preserving the same social-spatial dimensions in negative form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit enemy-to-intimate transformation and a later far-schism state; I infer that the former is an inverse model for the latter, while the alternative is to keep 41:34 interpersonal and 41:52 solely epistemic.

changed_reading.before: Far schism is a settled category with no mechanism or inverse in view.
changed_reading.after: Far schism is the unrepaired form of a relation whose distance can, elsewhere in the same discourse, be actively collapsed by a better counter-response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs precede the focus question and promised showing follows it. Seeing humbled earth move into life, then being shown signs across horizons and selves until truth becomes clear, makes أرأيتم a hinge between available observation and continuing disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The focus alert asks hearers to report what follows from considered seeing.
A visible sign marks the earth episode as evidentiary rather than decorative.
Direct perception of the earth supplies an already available act of seeing.
The earth's life-like movement turns the sign into an observable transition.
Caused showing extends the focus demand into a future disclosure process.
Marks distributed through horizons and selves provide the objects to be shown.
Emergence into clarity supplies the stated endpoint of showing.
Stable correspondence with reality names what the signs are to clarify.
Knowledgeable testimony closes the evidentiary sequence.

structural_cues: 41:39 uses ترى before the focus, 41:52 uses أرأيتم, and 41:53 uses سنريهم.
The sequence progresses from a seen sign, through a diagnostic question, to signs shown until clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a three-stage seeing sequence around the focus; I infer that 41:52 functions as its epistemic hinge, while the alternative is that 41:53 begins a new promise rather than extending the focus challenge.

changed_reading.before: أرأيتم introduces an unanswerable rhetorical hypothetical detached from evidence.
changed_reading.after: أرأيتم occupies the threshold between signs already observable and signs still to be shown, asking for a provisional judgment that later clarification can test.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence moves from a self-assured claim of good at God, through physically taking one's side far away, to a challenge about something from God's presence and a far opposite side. Bodily withdrawal exposes the instability of claimed nearness and supplies the motion that becomes شقاق بعيد.

activation_trace.role: Provenance from divine presence supplies the genuine-nearness pole.
The opposite side names the posture produced by lateral withdrawal.
Remoteness states the completed extent of that posture.
Nearness and standing are appropriated in the speaker's confident claim of reserved good.
Taking one's side away supplies an enacted movement of distancing.
The bodily side makes the withdrawal spatially concrete.
Estrangement and self-removal convert the bodily gesture into relational separation.

structural_cues: 41:50 claims لِى عِندَهُ لَلْحُسْنَى, 41:51 says نَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِ, and 41:52 contrasts مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ with شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ.
The three consecutive ayat move from claimed proximity, through sideward withdrawal, to explicit far-sidedness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent claim, gesture, and spatial verdict; I infer that the sequence tests professed nearness against enacted withdrawal, while the alternative is that 41:50 and 41:51 are parallel human types rather than stages in one trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah abruptly labels rejection as remote schism.
changed_reading.after: The label completes a visible movement: self-awarded standing near God is contradicted by taking one's own side away until that posture hardens into a far opposite side.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fruit-cover branch inside the focus root كفر through the immediately preceding image of fruit leaving its coverings. It remains anchored in كفرتم and in packet-backed خروج, ثمر, and أكمام branches, but downstream prose should present it only as a material counterimage, not as the lexical equivalence or primary sense of كفرتم.

activation_trace.role: The focus inventory's fruit-cover image lets covering be imagined as a sheath that withholds emergence.
Emergence from hiddenness supplies motion outward from enclosure.
Ripened fruit supplies the object ready to emerge.
The plant's sheath is the explicit neighboring material covering from which fruit comes out.

changed_reading.before: كفرتم is considered only as propositional denial.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, rejection acts like keeping a ripened disclosure shut in its sheath precisely where the surrounding sequence depicts signs and fruit emerging from coverings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ن ش ق mapping for شقاق and connects its snare to later doubt and encompassing knowledge. It remains anchored in the focus word شقاق and every added image is packet-resolvable, but downstream prose should label it an exploratory topology of entrapment rather than an etymology of شقاق.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped branch recasts being in schism as being caught in a loop from which release is difficult.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty supply the loop's cognitive motion.
Persistent doubt and hesitation keep the subject oscillating within the split.
Complete encompassing knowledge supplies the larger field within which attempted remoteness cannot actually escape.

changed_reading.before: Far schism suggests free-standing distance outside the opposed object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the schism is a self-tightening snare of unresolved alternatives: subjectively far away, yet still enclosed within what fully encompasses and knows it.

strongest_changes: The source conditional becomes a compressed test of rejecting a repeatedly delivered and articulated object.
Far schism becomes a manufactured communication distance built from coverings, ear-weight, barriers, and deliberate noise.
The shared ثم sets upright alignment and covering fracture on opposed post-divine trajectories.
The immediate sequence converts claimed nearness into bodily sideward withdrawal and finally far-sidedness.
أرأيتم becomes the hinge between signs already seen and signs promised to be shown until clarity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted abstract predicates in 41:52 into mechanisms: source became delivery, disbelief became covering and failed concealment, misguidance became chosen anti-reception, and distant schism became a spatial, auditory, bodily, and potentially reversible relation.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from covering to hiddenness and from reception barriers to distance are reader-supplied causal inferences rather than explicit grammatical statements.
The contrast between the two ثم sequences is structurally strong but could be coincidental rather than an intended cross-ayah parallel.
The fruit-sheath and snare readings depend on branch-distant material images and should remain exploratory rather than control the primary rendering.
